candidates.intended: EP. 001 'I controlled my computer without touching it'
candidates.verdict: rejected for the briefed episode (producer chose a different repository)
verified: Hand tracking via @mediapipe/tasks-vision HandLandmarker (21 landmarks per hand) in a browser page or an Electron wrapper.
Gesture recognition: ran the project's own GestureEngine and detectors (src/js/recognition) in Node on scripted landmark sequences; swipe, pinch start/move/end, OK and open-palm events fired.
blockers: No operating-system input code: the cursor is never moved and no click is injected (no robotjs / nut.js / native module; electron/preload.js exposes only platform info and three IPC channels).

Actions run only inside the app's own page (src/js/actions/actionRegistry.js): swipe up/down = window.scrollBy, swipe left/right = synthetic KeyboardEvent on its own document, push/open palm = pause <video> elements on the page, peace = fullscreen.
Pinch start/move/end, pinch volume and OK are log-only TODO stubs.
The briefed hook (cursor follows the hand, pinch to click, 'controlled my computer') is therefore not supported by the code.
candidates.not_tested: No webcam is available in the build environment; MediaPipe inference was not run on real video.
